[SWS_CM_00036] Deserialization of the data according to the network binding for method request
⌈
For the given E2E-protected Method request, the re-
sulting serialized data shall be deserialized according to the rules of the respective
network binding (e.g., according to [SWS_CM_10304] in case of SOME/IP network
binding), resulting in the deserialized in and inout arguments to the Method call.
⌋
